definitions in kernel slash maps dot c configure packet counter map as a bpf map type percpu hash with max entries configured to one million entries and pin map flag set to bpf obj pin any. in the rust userspace collector daemon inspect src slash daemon slash collector dot rs and verify that ring buffer consumer initializes with buffer size of sixteen megabytes to prevent dropped packet events under bursty workloads. the userspace daemon must accept command line arguments dash dash prom dash export on port nine thousand one hundred dash dash bpf dash map dash size set to one million and dash dash kernel dash tracepoint configured to netif receive skb. in the ebpf kernel probe program verify that tcp connection tracker inspects tcphdr flags to accurately count syn ack and fin packets without triggering kernel verifier rejections for unbounded loop execution. the principal systems engineer confirmed that bpf verifier log level must be set to zero in production to minimize kernel memory overhead scratch that set to one during debugging sessions. the daemon must also track socket buffer allocations in sk_buff structures and emit histogram distributions for connection establishment latency. under no circumstances should any developer disable kernel bpf verifier safety checks using debug kernel parameters. in addition inspect build scripts in makefile and cargo dot toml to verify that clang compiles bpf objects with dash o two and dash target bpf flags. the userspace rust daemon must handle unix signals sigint and sigterm gracefully by closing ring buffer subscriptions and unpinning ebpf maps from sys fs bpf telemetry. verify that synthetic traffic benchmarks generated by iperf three reach ten gigabits per second throughput with cpu utilization remaining under five percent across all worker cores. all metrics exported to prometheus must adhere to open telemetry semantic conventions using snake case metric names including network packets total and tcp connection duration seconds. incident response coordinators must also confirm that kernel warning messages are monitored in var log messages via systemd journald telemetry pipes. the infrastructure security group requires that the binary collector executable run under non root service accounts using linux capabilities cap bpf cap net admin and cap perfmon. in addition the integration test harness in tests slash integration slash ebpf test dot rs must execute in github workflows using github actions runners with kernel version five point fifteen or newer. furthermore verify that helper functions in libbpf dot c utilize bpf trace printk strictly for development builds and remove all kernel printk calls from release binaries. the rust daemon must also implement exponential backoff reconnection logic when communication with the local prometheus node exporter fails starting with initial interval of one hundred milliseconds capped at ten seconds. inspect dockerfile dot daemon to ensure multi stage docker builds discard clang compilation dependencies and produce minimal scratch based deployment containers. the site reliability team requires automated alerts in datadog when ring buffer dropped event ratio exceeds zero point zero one percent over five minute intervals. in the kernel probe directory examine filter dot c to verify that sock filter bytecodes validate ipv4 and ipv6 header checksums before processing payload slices. all bpf tail calls must use static jump tables with a maximum depth limit of thirty-two calls to prevent kernel stack overflow errors. the memory management team requires that memory cgroup limits for the collector daemon be configured to five hundred twelve megabytes in systemd unit definitions. inspect scripts slash deploy slash telemetry dot service to verify that restart policy is set to on failure with restart security delay of five seconds. the network operations center confirmed that bpf map dumps must be exportable to json format using bpftool map dump id for offline incident analysis. moreover the collector daemon must log all unrecognized packet protocols to audit log files with rate limiting capped at ten messages per second. verify that clang optimization passes preserve volatile memory pointers when reading hardware timestamps from bpf ktime get ns helper calls. security compliance requires that all ebpf program bytecode binaries be cryptographically signed using kernel module signing keys before loading into memory. the automated fuzzing suite in tests slash fuzz slash packet fuzzer dot c must run continuously for forty-eight hours without triggering kernel panics. in addition check file reference sysctl dot conf in the system configuration directory to confirm that net core bpf jit enable is set to one. the platform security auditor requires that bpf program load events be logged to auditd daemon with process identity and file path. moreover the collector daemon must verify that kernel page table isolation is active before allocating shared bpf ring buffer memory maps. finally schedule an architectural review with the linux platform infrastructure manager on wednesday at two pm to approve production deployment across edge gateway nodes.
